name: hcapp_getRunPhotos
description: Returns photos for a run in two rowsets. Rowset 1 — own photos (all statuses, always fully returned, includes AssetId for device-local display). Rowset 2 — others' public photos (status >= 2, soft-deleted excluded, filterable by @afterUpdatedAt for incremental updates). Call on-demand when the map or photo UI is active; do not poll.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The run to fetch photos for. Null or zero-UUID triggers a validation error (errorCode 1232, errorType 12).

parameters.name: afterUpdatedAt
parameters.description: Incremental watermark applied to others' public photos only (rowset 2). NULL = return all matching records (initial load). Non-null = return only records where UpdatedAt > @afterUpdatedAt. Own photos (rowset 1) always return fully regardless of this value. Defaults to NULL.

rowsets.name: AuthErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned only on auth or validation failure. Contains {success, errorCode, errorType}. Not present on success.
Returned only on auth or validation failure (paired with AuthErrorEnvelope at index 0). Not present on success.

rowsets.name: OwnPhotos
rowsets.description: On success: all photos uploaded by the authenticated user for this event, regardless of status (including private and soft-deleted). Always fully returned — @afterUpdatedAt does not apply. Includes AssetId for device-local display fallback. Zero rows if the user has no photos for this event. Mutually exclusive with StandardErrorResult at index 1.

columns.name: UserId
columns.description: KennelPhotos.UserId — always the authenticated user's ID in this rowset.

columns.name: BlobUrl
columns.description: KennelPhotos.BlobUrl — CDN URL of the original uploaded image.

columns.name: EditedBlobUrl
columns.description: KennelPhotos.EditedBlobUrl — CDN URL of the edited version, if any.

columns.name: AssetId
columns.description: KennelPhotos.AssetId — device-library identifier (iOS/Android). Only valid on the device that took the photo. NULL if the user had camera roll saving disabled.

rowsets.name: OthersPublicPhotos
rowsets.description: On success: photos from other users where Status >= 2 and DeletedAt IS NULL, filtered by @afterUpdatedAt when non-null. Includes uploaderDisplayName for attribution. Zero rows if no qualifying others' photos exist (or none updated since @afterUpdatedAt). Not present on error paths.

columns.name: UserId
columns.description: KennelPhotos.UserId — the uploader's ID (never the authenticated user in this rowset).

columns.name: BlobUrl
columns.description: KennelPhotos.BlobUrl — CDN URL of the original uploaded image.

columns.name: EditedBlobUrl
columns.description: KennelPhotos.EditedBlobUrl — CDN URL of the edited version, if any.

columns.name: Status
columns.description: KennelPhotos.Status — always >= 2 in this rowset (filter predicate enforces it).

columns.name: UpdatedAt
columns.description: KennelPhotos.UpdatedAt — UTC last-modified timestamp. Used as the incremental watermark on the next call.

columns.name: uploaderDisplayName
columns.description: Hasher.DisplayName (persisted computed column) — the display name of the uploader.

sideEffects: Writes to HC.ErrorLog on eventId validation failure.

codeSmells.issue: No TRY/CATCH around the main SELECTs
codeSmells.detail: The SP has no TRY/CATCH block. An unexpected DB error (deadlock, timeout) will propagate as a raw SQL error rather than a structured error rowset.

codeSmells.issue: OthersPublicPhotos uses Status >= 2 not Status IN (2,3,4,5)
codeSmells.detail: The filter uses kp.Status >= 2. This would include any future status values above 5 without an explicit review. A closed IN list would be more defensive, though currently Status only goes to 5.

codeSmells.issue: HcVersion hardcoded to '<unknown>' in all ErrorLog inserts
codeSmells.detail: Consistent with other HC6 SPs but means the version is never captured in the error log.

breakingChanges: New SP — no HC5 predecessor. No breaking changes from migration.
